app.title: PlumbobForge
app.cache_optimization_message: PlumbobForge no longer compresses your CC, which could slow down the game. Repair your library once to restore your packages to how their creators shipped them, then rebuild the cache.

conflicts.title: Conflict Scanner
conflicts.subtitle: Detect duplicate packages, resource overrides, and mod incompatibilities.

conflicts.clean_desc: Your CC library and active configuration are clean of known duplicate resources and script overrides.
conflicts.bulk_duplicates_desc: Automatically keep the active copy in each duplicate group and disable redundant copies to save memory and load time.

collections.title: Collection Creator
collections.subtitle: Create, edit, and organize build-buy catalog collections directly from your PlumbobForge sets.
collections.empty_desc: No Sims 3 collection files (.package) were found in your Collections folder.
collections.catalog_hidden_tip: Objects in this collection are hidden from the Buy/Build catalog
collections.editor_desc: Customize collection details, select an in-game category icon, and assign CC sets.
collections.external_desc: This collection was created outside of PlumbobForge. Saving will update it into a PlumbobForge collection and replace its items with your assigned sets.
collections.hide_desc: Generates a package in Mods\Overrides that hides objects in this collection in other categories. You can still find them in the collection.
collections.click_add: Click '+ Add' on any set below to include it in this collection.
collections.included_items_desc: Single Build/Buy items from other sets, without adding their whole set

appearance.title: Appearance & Personalization
appearance.theme_help: Choose between dark mode, clean light mode, or follow your operating system appearance.
appearance.accent_color_help: Customizes button highlights, toggles, badges, and focus rings across the app.
appearance.language_help: Select your display language. Changes take effect immediately.
appearance.custom_theme_desc: Choose a base color and mode. PlumbobForge mathematically generates a cohesive, readable palette.
appearance.base_color_help: Hex code (#RRGGBB) or choose a starter tone below.
appearance.autogen_accent_help: Derives a vibrant accent color directly from your base color.
appearance.custom_accent_help: Specify a dedicated accent hex code (#RRGGBB).
appearance.tint_strength_help: Adjusts how prominently the chosen palette color tints backgrounds, cards, and UI surfaces.
appearance.use_custom_accent_help: Override the automatically generated accent color with your own.

storage.title: Storage & Paths
storage.library_dir_help: Location where your raw CC .package files and set folders are stored.
storage.game_dir_help: Your The Sims 3 folder where the game files are stored.
storage.sims3_user_dir_help: Location of your The Sims 3 user folder (inside Documents/Electronic Arts). Automatically detected if left empty.

observed.title: Monitored Folders & Auto-Import
observed.auto_scan_help: Automatically detect and import new packages found in monitored folders when starting PlumbobForge.

performance.title: In-Game Performance
performance.auto_clear_caches_desc: Deletes CASPartCache and the other caches whenever the CC the game loads change, so it never starts with stale data.

textures.optimize_desc: Checks your CC for unoptimised textures with an optional size limit. Because most CC creators already optimise their files, results may vary. Your original files are never changed, and you can exclude items from the toolbar.

mode.title: Storage Mode
mode.subtitle: Library or vault mode, cache options
mode.library_desc: Your original files stay in the library, and PlumbobForge builds a cache from them for the game.
mode.vault_desc: Your CC is stored once in the vault and the game reads it directly, so there is nothing to rebuild.

engine.dynamic_cache_desc: Dynamic Cache: Builds separate caches per set. Faster rebuild times, hot-swappable configurations, and flexible set updates.
engine.static_bundle_desc: Static Bundle: Merges all active sets into a single bundle to maximize in-game loading performance. Any change requires a full rebuild.
engine.auto_rebuild_static_desc: Automatically rebuild the static bundle immediately whenever configurations are switched or sets are enabled/disabled. When disabled, changes are marked pending so you can make multiple edits before rebuilding.

maintenance.title: Maintenance & Diagnostics
maintenance.help: Repair corrupted database entries, re-verify package types, or run the migration wizard.
maintenance.recheck_types_desc: Re-checks the category of your items.
maintenance.autofix_desc: Checks for issues in your database.
maintenance.migration_tool_desc: Import sets, profiles, and files from CC Magic or Sims 3 Mod Organizer (S3MO).

thanks.title: About & Credits
thanks.peter_desc: for the foundational s3pi binary library

vault.desc_inactive: You're currently on Library mode which keeps two copies of your CC (original files + merged cache). Upgrading to Vault Mode eliminates duplicate files, cutting your CC disk space in half and lets you change configs in seconds even if you use Static Bundle.
vault.upgrade_safety: You can always revert back to Library mode.
vault.cleanup_desc: Reclaims free space from mods you've deleted or updated, and optimizes file layout for faster game loading.
vault.revert_desc: Restores your original files and returns the app to the default mode.

vault_revert.title: Revert to Library Mode
vault_revert.subtitle: Library Mode keeps a copy of all items in PlumbobForge\Library and requires rebuilds. Vault shard files in Mods\PF_Vault will be removed once your files are restored.
vault_revert.option_folder_desc: Moves your intact original files from PlumbobForge\Library_Backup back into the Library.
vault_revert.option_zip_desc: Extracts your original files from Library_Backup.zip into the Library.
vault_revert.option_vault_desc: Extracts all items directly from the Vault shards into library files. Recommended only if you do not have a backup folder or zip.
vault_revert.preserve_delta: Export any newly added Vault items not found in backup (Recommended)

vault_migration.title: Switch to Vault Mode
vault_migration.subtitle: PlumbobForge will convert your CC into Vault shards. Choose what you want to do with your original files:
vault_migration.option_zip_desc: Compresses files into Library_Backup.zip and clears the Library folder. Gives you an emergency backup while immediately freeing up disk space.
vault_migration.option_keep_desc: Renames the folder to Library_Backup. Keeps all original files intact on disk, but continues using disk space until you manually delete it.
vault_migration.option_delete_desc: Deletes original files immediately after migrating into the Vault. Saves 50% storage space right away.

walkthrough.title: Getting Started with PlumbobForge
walkthrough.welcome_sub: The fresh CC manager and organizer for The Sims 3. Let's take a quick look around and set things up the way you like.
walkthrough.library_desc: Your home. Every .package and .Sims3Pack you add is here, sorted into sets you can browse, search and inspect.
walkthrough.library_f1_desc: Group CC into folders by style, type, and more. Drag items between sets and give each one an icon and color.
walkthrough.library_f2_desc: Narrow down by category, type, your own tags, and much more.
walkthrough.library_f3_desc: See and change thumbnails, check what's inside a file and switch single items on or off.
walkthrough.configs_desc: For all of you gameplay needs. Each configuration decides which sets the game loads.
walkthrough.configs_f1_desc: One for your Victorian legacy, one for sci-fi, a lightweight one for testing.
walkthrough.configs_f2_desc: Switch sets on or off per configuration. Only active sets reach the game.
walkthrough.configs_f3_title: One click to do it all
walkthrough.configs_f3_desc: Pick the active configuration before you launch. No moving files around by hand.
walkthrough.tools_desc: Utilities that keep your game fast, healthy, or just help you out.
walkthrough.tools_settings_hint: Everything else lives in the Settings tab. Everything you choose in this setup can be changed there later.
walkthrough.mode_title: How should PlumbobForge store your CC?
walkthrough.mode_desc: This decides how you treat  your files. Not sure? Library with Dynamic Cache is a safe start.
walkthrough.mode_dynamic_desc: Keeps your original files in the Library folder and builds a separate cache per set. Rebuilds are quick and configurations swap easily.
walkthrough.mode_static_desc: Merges all active sets into one bundle. Any change needs a full rebuild. Best if you keep many smaller sets.
walkthrough.mode_vault_desc: Stores each item once in shards that the game reads directly. No duplicate copies, about half the disk space, and no rebuilds.
walkthrough.mode_note: You can switch modes anytime in Settings. Leaving the Vault puts your files back in the Library.
walkthrough.import_desc: PlumbobForge can bring over your packages, sets and configurations from CC Magic or Sims 3 Mod Organizer.
walkthrough.fresh_desc: Starting fresh? Just click Next. You can migrate anytime from the Settings tab.
walkthrough.import_failed: Something went wrong during the import. Try again, or restart the app; if it keeps failing, please report it.
walkthrough.import_result_full_s3mo: Imported {0} items, {1} sets and {2} configurations from Sims 3 Mod Organizer.
walkthrough.import_result_simple_s3mo: Imported {0} items from Sims 3 Mod Organizer.
walkthrough.import_result_full_ccmagic: Imported {0} items, {1} sets, {2} configurations and {3} collections from CC Magic.
walkthrough.import_vault_note: You picked the Vault: imported items move into it when you finish setup.
walkthrough.personalize_desc: Pick a theme and an accent color. The preview updates as you choose.
walkthrough.accent_desc: Used for buttons, toggles, active tabs and highlights across the app.
walkthrough.custom_theme_hint: Want something more personal? Try the Custom Theme in Settings later to build your own palette.
walkthrough.ready_desc: Here's how PlumbobForge is set up. You can change any of it in Settings.

upgrade.title: Welcome to PlumbobForge
upgrade.welcome_sub: Completely rewritten with an enhanced engine, better interface, and new tools for The Sims 3
upgrade.feat_engine_desc: Ultra-fast package indexing, faster cache rebuilding, low memory footprint, and instant search.

look_inside.title: Look Inside
look_inside.switch_item: Show the objects of every selected item, or of one
look_inside.all_items_desc: Changes here apply to every object in this item. Each object can still be changed on its own.
look_inside.all_items_mixed: A box with a small square means the objects differ. Click it to set it for all of them.
look_inside.all_items_skipped_cas: {0} CAS part(s) can't be changed and are left as they are.
look_inside.error_missing_file: The item's file is missing. It may have been moved or deleted outside PlumbobForge.
look_inside.error_read: Something went wrong while reading it: {0}
look_inside.error_damaged: This file looks damaged or incomplete (for example a download that did not finish), so its contents cannot be read.
look_inside.warning_encrypted: This Sims3Pack is encrypted, so its contents cannot be read.
look_inside.warning_corrupt: This Sims3Pack looks damaged; some of its contents may be missing.
look_inside.warning_missing_shard: The vault file holding {0} is missing.
look_inside.warning_unreadable_objects: {0} object(s) could not be read and are shown without details.
look_inside.in_game_tip: Turn off to keep this object out of the game. The item's file is not changed.
look_inside.valid_for_random_tip: Lets the game put this part on Sims it creates, such as townies and newly born Sims.
look_inside.duplicate_key_note: Can't be changed here: another resource in this package has the same key, and saving would keep only one of them.
look_inside.off_note_bb: The game won't load this object. Copies already placed on a lot disappear from it.
look_inside.off_note_cas: The game won't load this CAS part. Sims wearing it change to another outfit or hairstyle.
look_inside.all_off_note: Every object in this item is turned off. Disabling the whole item in the library does the same and is easier to undo.
look_inside.no_objects: This item has no CAS parts or Build/Buy objects.
look_inside.select_object: Select an object to see its details.
look_inside.could_not_read: This resource could not be read, so its details are missing.
look_inside.other_thumbnails_desc: Thumbnails in this item that no CAS part or object points to.
look_inside.matched_by_package: These thumbnails are not linked to the object by key; they are shown here because it is the only object in its package.
look_inside.matched_by_package_one: This thumbnail is not linked to the object by key; it is shown here because it is the only object in its package.
look_inside.pick_folder: Choose where to save the thumbnails
look_inside.export_done_with_failures: Exported {0} thumbnail(s); {1} could not be read and were skipped.
look_inside.image_invalid: That file is not an image PlumbobForge can read (use PNG, JPG, BMP, WebP or GIF).
look_inside.save_failed: Could not save, nothing was changed: {0}
look_inside.save_toggles_failed: The thumbnails were saved, but turning objects on or off failed: {0}
look_inside.saved_rebuild: Saved {0} change(s). Rebuild to apply them in the game.
look_inside.game_running: Close The Sims 3 before saving. Your changes are still here.
look_inside.game_running_unsaved: The Sims 3 was started while saving, so nothing was changed. Close the game and make the changes again.
look_inside.cache_note: The game keeps its own copies of thumbnails. If it still shows the old ones, clear the Thumbnails Cache in Tools → Cache Cleaner.
look_inside.editing_unavailable: This item can be viewed but not edited, because part of it could not be read.
